title: msfslogger windows-client config.json (design section 2)
description: Reference schema. Not wired into any build: the sidecar validates in code (windows-client/sidecar/src/config.ts) because it must produce one human-readable line per problem, not a schema dump. Keep both in step; the schema is the reviewer's cross-check.

version.description: Schema version. Absent is read as 1.

serverUrl.description: Replaces SERVER_URL. Required. http: or https: only. Trailing slashes are stripped on load.

ingestToken.description: Replaces INGEST_TOKEN. Required. Sent as the x-ingest-token header. Stored in plaintext, exactly as the env var was. Must never be logged, emitted over IPC or rendered.

certPath.description: Replaces NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS. Absolute path to the server's PEM certificate. null/absent = system trust store only.

trafficEnabled.description: Replaces TRAFFIC_ENABLED. False only when String(value).trim().toLowerCase() is one of 0, false, off, no. Anything else, including absent and empty, is true.

trafficRadiusM.description: Replaces TRAFFIC_RADIUS_M. Number(value) then Math.round then clamp to [1000, 200000]. Non-finite falls back to 40000 with a warning.

sim.description: Replaces --sim/-s. One of 2020 (Protocol.KittyHawk), 2024 (Protocol.SunRise), fsx (Protocol.FSX_SP2). The loader trims and lowercases before comparing, so "FSX" and " 2024 " are accepted on disk; the enum below is the canonical form the UI writes back. Anything else is rejected.

autoUplink.description: New in the Tauri client. When false (the default) the app opens idle and the user presses START.

nodePath.description: Advanced escape hatch, read only by the Tauri shell and never shown in the FMC pages: absolute path to node.exe when it is not on PATH.
